draft.notice: Your draft stays in memory while this page is open. It is not saved to disk, not put in the address and is lost when you reload.

prefill.refused: These address parameters were not used because they are longer than {{limit}} characters: {{names}}.

fixed.label: Delivery settings that cannot be changed
fixed.mandatory: Mandatory is always on: if the broker finds no queue for this exchange and routing key, it returns the message and this page says so.
fixed.confirm: Publisher confirms are always on: each copy waits for the broker's confirm, or times out.

form.exchangeHint: Leave empty for the default exchange. The routing key is then the name of a queue.

headers.typedHint: Decimal, list and table values are typed as JSON. Bytes are base64.
headers.jsonHint: Each header is written as {"t": its type, "v": its value}.
headers.switchRow: A header needs fixing before the JSON can be shown. Fix the marked row first.
headers.switchJson: The JSON is not valid. Fix it before going back to the table.
headers.switchShape: The JSON is not a table of typed headers. Fix it before going back to the table.

body.label: Message body
body.highlightingNote: XML and YAML are coloured only; they are not checked.

editor.hint: Press Ctrl+M to let the Tab key leave the editor.
editor.fallback: The code editor could not be loaded, so a plain text box is used. Nothing is lost.

issues.summary: {{count}} to fix before this can be sent.
issues.invalidBase64: This is not valid base64 text.
issues.invalidJson: The headers JSON is not valid or is not a table of typed headers. Fix it or go back to the table.
issues.overLimit: The body is over the limit of {{limit}} bytes.
issues.tooDeep: Lists and tables can be nested at most {{limit}} levels.
issues.duplicate: Another header has the same name.
issues.badValue: This value does not fit its type.
issues.invalid: The message does not fit the publish contract.
